package.name: waypoint_recorder
package.description: Core library for recording the arm's current /joint_states into a named "*Angle" waypoint in a sequence.yaml (single-shot or interactive loop), plus a targeted-text-insertion yaml writer that preserves comments. Used by builds/openarm_demo's record_waypoint CLI and any future project that wants to record waypoints (CLI, BT node, GUI, ...) without reimplementing the capture/write logic.
